attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (apt package, since nodes are i686/32-bit and modern etcd binaries/Go toolchain aren't available for that arch) statically bootstrapped across node1 (10.100.70.10), node2 (10.100.70.11), node3 (10.100.70.12) via /etc/default/etcd. Verified cross-member replication (writes from node1 and node3 readable on all members), verified continued read/write availability with node3 stopped (quorum preserved via node1+node2), verified node3 caught up on the key written while it was down after rejoining. Completed mandatory sequential reboot protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, rebooted one at a time with systemctl reboot, confirmed connection-refused during the outage window, polled until SSH/exec returned, confirmed boot_id changed on each node, and confirmed etcd cluster-health showed all 3 members healthy plus all previously written keys readable after each restart before moving to the next node.
